title: LRO LOLA surface roughness, 16 pixel/degree (LDRM_16 V2.0, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0)

statements.text: David E. Smith and the NASA GSFC LRO LOLA team; the label cites Zuber et al. (2012), Nature 486, 378-381, doi:10.1038/nature11216. NASA PDS Geosciences Node.
statements.evidence: PDS3 label PRODUCER_FULL_NAME and DESCRIPTION [ZUBERETAL2012]; LOLA ref.cat.

statements.text: Publicly archived NASA mission scientific data; preserve producer and PDS citation.

Roughness is the residual standard deviation of altitudes from three successive laser shots after fitting a plane to 5 to 15 profile returns, averaged per pixel; the baseline varies from 30 to 120 m with orbital velocity, detection and altitude, so values are not tied to one scale. Data through mission phase LRO_SM_17 (2009-07-13 to 2011-12-11). -32768 marks pixels without a value.
statements.evidence: PDS3 label DESCRIPTION and IMAGE object.
